observations: I opened assets/panels/05-4.png, main-cast.png and page-05.png with Read.

Ravi steps out toward screen-right in sunlight, smiling. His raised waving hand is on his screen-left side, which is his right. His left hand, wearing the watch, holds the dark phone low at his side. His bag hangs from a shoulder strap. This matches production.hands.ravi and the ravi-phone and shoulder-bag props.

Ananya and Meera stand in the glass doorway at left, under a teal awning. Ananya (coat, stethoscope, teal kurta, tied hair) waves with her right hand, with her left hand at her side. Meera (braid, blue kurta) waves with her left hand, with her right at her side. Both match the record, and their faces match the sheet at this small scale.
The street, trees and planters are drawn simply. There is no signage or text.

Non-blocking continuity note: here the bag hangs at Ravi's right hip with the strap over his left shoulder. In 05-1 it hangs at his left side, and the cast sheet shows it on his right shoulder. The carry side is not consistent across the comic, but it does not affect this beat.

Lettering on page-05.png: the art has a hard-edged white rectangle across the top-left, which cuts off the wall's shadow pattern. The caption box covers most of it. A narrow white band is left below and to the left of the caption, which at page scale reads as caption margin. Non-blocking, but avoid leaving the straight cut edge visible if the panel is ever regenerated.
